scripts.format: find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -exec basename {} \; | grep -Ev 'common|out|vendor' | xargs -I{} sh -c 'find {} -type f | xargs -n 1 -- jsonnetfmt -i'
scripts.lint: find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -exec basename {} \; | grep -Ev 'common|out|vendor' | xargs -I{} sh -c 'find {} -type f | while read f; do jsonnetfmt "$f" | diff -u "$f" -; done'
scripts.build: find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -exec basename {} \; | grep -Ev 'common|out|vendor' | while read d; do mkdir -p out/$d && jsonnet -J vendor -V output=alerts -S $d/gen.jsonnet > out/$d/prometheus_alerts.yaml && jsonnet -J vendor -V output=dashboards -m out/$d $d/gen.jsonnet 1>/dev/null && jsonnet -J vendor -V output=rules -S $d/gen.jsonnet > out/$d/prometheus_rules.yaml; done
scripts.sync: find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -exec basename {} \; | grep -Ev 'common|out|vendor' | xargs -I{} bash common/sync.sh {}
